scoring_justification: Checker recomputes the orbital character match from the raw strings (atom/orbital token set) rather than trusting the exact string. Band gap is compared to the paper's gold with tolerance; full credit when within ±0.3 eV, linear partial credit up to ±0.6 eV.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold band gap and orbital assignments
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper: direct band gap of about 5.1 eV; HOMO: O p states; LUMO: Si/Al p and s states.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values extracted from paper text and used in reference solve.sh.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's reported quantities for the pristine MASO host; they constrain the reproduction without being arbitrary.

outputs.description: Extracted direct band gap at the Γ point and the DFT settings used.
Dominant atomic-orbital character of the HOMO and LUMO.

output_contract.notes: Only results for the pristine MASO host are scored.
